defects.detail: Star arrives at actual near paw, holds outside face, then releases; all four views and four looks checked.
Preparation/wake/stretch no longer retain sleep Z. Drowsy and sleep accents stay appropriate; explicit sleep eyes remain closed.
General six phases missed exact catches; six exact alternating endpoints visibly contact the paws. Production motion was already correct.
Artist ring attachment replaces fixed and moving-center duplicate streams; eight view/facing composites independently inspected at normal and expanded size.

limitations: Offscreen visual review is not native Electron/GPU/desktop acceptance or user aesthetic acceptance.
No memory risk checks or new dependencies were run/installed.
All current rows have normal-size phase inspection; expanded images were generated for all, but only targeted expanded images were individually inspected.
The 59 normal-speed videos are encoded and metadata-verified; selected decoded frames were inspected, but a human-equivalent full normal-speed playback review is not claimed.
Coverage is finite: all catalog actions and story phases with bare plus three curated looks; targeted requested-view sweeps, not every possible mixed outfit or every action/view Cartesian product.
Rig sleep and chew are dormant live capabilities. Feeding currently emits surprised/hungry/satisfied expressions; diagnostic chew rendering is not evidence of live feed-to-chew integration.
Curious is the form fallback; normal no-action expressions use idle bones.
All source generation masters and production assets remain unchanged by this audit.

Original 732 action/expression/story rows and replay videos are body-only captures. The eight new bubble rows explicitly composite scene + body + overlay; they do not retroactively establish overlay review of all earlier rows.
